description:
In a face off between the Toronto Maple Leafs and the Ottawa Senators, rookie goaltender Joseph Woll delivered a stellar performance, securing a road victory for his team in the heated "Battle of Ontario" matchup. In the midst of a scoreless first period, Ottawa gained a two-on-one opportunity down low, but Woll showcased his brilliance with an incredible glove save, denying what seemed to be a certain goal by Vladimir Tarasenko. Woll's stellar play continued in the same period when he thwarted Rourke Chartier's attempt in the slot. As the game progressed into the second period with the score tied at one goal apiece, Woll once again stood tall thwarting Tarasenko's attempt on the far side, maintaining the deadlock. Despite leaving the game with just under ten minutes to play due to injury, Woll was key to the Toronto victory, making a total of 29 saves. His outstanding efforts did not go unnoticed, as he was rightfully named the game’s “First Star,” solidifying his impact on the ice in the Battle of Ontario clash.
